# gdrive_shared_drive (Data Source)

Look up a Shared Drive by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gdrive_shared_drive" "engineering" {
  id = "SHARED_DRIVE_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Shared Drive ID.

### Read-Only

- `admin_managed_restrictions` (Boolean) Current Shared Drive restriction setting.
- `copy_requires_writer_permission` (Boolean) Current Shared Drive restriction setting.
- `domain_users_only` (Boolean) Current Shared Drive restriction setting.
- `drive_members_only` (Boolean) Current Shared Drive restriction setting.
- `name` (String) Shared Drive name.
- `sharing_folders_requires_organizer_permission` (Boolean) Current Shared Drive restriction setting.
